## Appearance

Marilla Cuthbert is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman characterized by a sharp, angular frame devoid of curves. Her dark hair, which exhibits gray streaks that have grown grayer over time, is typically twisted behind her head in a tight knot. She has sallow cheeks and hard, work-worn hands, though her face has noticeably softened despite appearing old, worn, and tired.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XIII. The Delights of Anticipation P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Personality

Sensible, practical, and orderly, Marilla Cuthbert approaches life with a stern and self-contained demeanor, viewing the world purely through prose. In raising a child, she is deeply committed to her duty, believing strongly in moral lessons and striving to drill a tranquil uniformity of disposition into her charge. Though she is critical, strict, and prone to sarcasm after showing vulnerability, she has nevertheless grown more mellow over time. She remains highly undemonstrative, repressed, and reluctant to openly express her deep affection or admit her pride. Beyond her household duties, she is locally celebrated for making homemade currant wine, is skilled at crafting round braided mats, and strongly detests cats.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for sixty years, having spent forty-five of them as neighbors with [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). In her youth, Marilla refused to forgive her suitor John Blythe after a quarrel, resulting in the end of their romance, and she spent the long years of her middle life in dull monotony. Having been raised under the strict rule that children should be seen and not heard, Marilla was shocked when an orphan girl, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), was mistakenly sent to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of a boy. Though initially intending to send her back, Marilla took pity on Anne's hard past and agreed to keep and educate her. Over time, despite Anne's dramatic blunders and a false confession regarding Marilla's inherited amethyst brooch, Marilla grew deeply affectionate toward the girl. When severe eye trouble forced Marilla to give up reading and sewing, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sacrificed her college scholarship to stay home and save [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Marilla later agreed to take in her late friend's orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), and she eventually invited the newly widowed Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could finally attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> "I don’t feel as if I wanted any more children to look after than I’ve got at present. You’re problem enough in all conscience. What’s to be done with you I don’t know. Matthew is a most ridiculous man."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P25](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0025)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you. You know that Anne’s behavior was dreadful, and yet you take her part! I suppose you’ll be saying next thing that she oughtn’t to be punished at all!"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P2](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0002)

> "She’ll have her meals regular, and I’ll carry them up to her myself. But she’ll stay up there until she’s willing to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, and that’s final, Matthew."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology P4](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla took [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a guardian after an orphan mix-up brought a young girl to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy she and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) expected. Though initially shocked and inclined to send her back, Marilla took pity on [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), resolved to raise her, and eventually became a mentor and good friend to her. Their relationship grew into one of deep affection, with Marilla helping to guide and educate [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) despite the girl's theatrical nature and fiery temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +23 more_

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Marilla and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) were brother and sister who lived together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) until Matthew's sudden death. While Marilla took a firmer, more disciplined approach to raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) quietly advocated for keeping her and often interceded to soften Marilla's strictness.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla is a third cousin to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and took him in as a guardian along with his twin sister. She commands authority over him, punishing and educating him for his constant misbehavior, dishonesty, and pranks. Despite the stress his mischievous behavior causes, Marilla holds a special affection for him.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), +12 more_
